name: Astral
pitch: Your WoW addons and interface, at home on every computer.
description: An addon manager for World of Warcraft Retail and Forever. It finds your installed addons, updates them with a backup first, and lets you roll back from Activity. It also syncs your addon settings, keybindings and layouts between computers, and keeps Raider.IO and other addons current once a day while WoW is closed.
